question:
By Interchanging the given two numbers which of the following equation will be correct?

5 and 9
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abe2c12fc9169ca1b1c3f1e7060d9a8ff33177f64eb7cb5384710e531422d694.png] 

Given numbers: 5 and 9

Option 1) 5 + 9 × 2 - 3 = 18

By Interchanging the given two numbers: 

⇒ 9 + __**5 **____**× 2**__ - 3 = 18

⇒ __**9 + **__**__**1**__0** - 3 = 18

⇒ **__19__**__** - 3**__ = 18

⇒ 15 = 18
